bug: Included project folder renamed in the system file manager while open: Changes said it was gone + a new project appeared; the renamed folder showed as a plain folder with the include strip
reason: Needs real OS file events (Windows reports a rename as two events, a move to another parent as a removal + a creation); the mock has no file watch. Covered by Rust tests with real renames: crates/core/src/projects/rename_tests.rs

bug: Locate... of a missing project opened the folder picker at another folder (the system's last one), not at the project's old parent or the opened folder
reason: The system folder picker is outside the page; the mock answers it at once. Covered by store.test.ts (folder the picker is asked to open at) + rename_tests.rs (old parent, else the opened folder)

bug: The mouse side buttons (back, forward) did nothing; in 0.5 they went back and forward through the documents viewed, like Alt+Left and Alt+Right
reason: The probe has no side-button step: Playwright mouse buttons are left | middle | right only, and a synthetic event in the page is what the vitest cases already send. Covered by dispatch.test.ts (button 3 | 4 -> back | forward, 0-2 pass, one step per press, overlay | dialog pass) + DocumentArea.test.ts (reading view and Source editor); the real button = real-input check
